in_marathi.name: Kyaati
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Love and Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kyaati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kyātī', meaning 'Goddess of Love and Fortune'. This name is associated with the goddess Parvati, symbolizing devotion, love, and prosperity.
